_comment: Three bundles assembled from packs already in the catalogue, so no new card sets are needed to ship them. Pricing follows the discount the existing bundles use: the Decades 5-Pack is $43.00 against $54.95 of singles (~22% off) and the Entertainers 3-Pack is $27.00 against $32.97 (~18% off). Names and prices are PROPOSALS — change them here and re-run. Each is staged (noindex, unlinked) until publish is set to true.
name: Word Nerd - Music Bingo 5-Pack
title: Word Nerd Music Bingo 5-Pack - Anagrams, Antonyms, Acronyms, Nicknames & Numbers
description: All five Fat City word-game music bingo packs in one download: Anagrams, Antonyms, Acronyms, Nicknames and Numbers. 250 cards each, with ready-made playlists.
body:
Five of our toughest music bingo games in one download — the ones that make a crowd argue.

What's included:

  • Anagrams — song titles with the letters scrambled.
  • Antonyms — every square is the opposite of the real title.
  • Acronyms — titles reduced to their initials.
  • Nicknames — artists by what everyone actually calls them.
  • Numbers — every song has a number in it.

Each game prints up to 250 randomized cards and comes with its callsheet and a ready-made Spotify and Apple Music playlist.

Buying all five separately costs $54.95.
